articleTitle: A way to improve the field of view of the radiotelescope with a dense focal plane array
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We consider a problem of increasing the field of view (FOV) of the radio telescope by means of multi beam performance of the prime focus hybrid reflector systems. It was shown that array feeds of waveguide and horn elements currently used cannot provide closely spaced beams over a wide FOV and a high aperture efficiency in each beam due to the element spacing restrictions imposed by a size of the element aperture. We proposed a feed design in a form of an integrated dense array with a small physical size of the grid element and a volumetric form of the array element. For the feed, the original excitation system of the array elements has been developed to perform the desirable beam illumination pattern with low spillover level. The results have been obtained both for theoretical and experimental radiation patterns of the array feed. Scanning and multi beam capabilities and limitations of the hybrid reflector antenna have been investigated on the basis of the focal field distribution analysis. As an example, 0.35 F/D ratio reflector (Westerbork Telescope) has been considered. It has been shown that the proposed array antenna is a good candidate be used as the feed to improve the properties of source images by the reflector systems and therefore to increase the FOV of the radio telescope.

articleTitle: Optimization of dielectric microwave heating by moving radiator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling of dielectrics microwave heating
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this work is the microwave heating of a semi-infinite dielectric layer at a known surface distribution of microwave power. The paper presents calculation results of the temperature in a dielectric layer for a single microwave radiator, as well as for a multi-element radiator system. We present an analytical discussion of the 2D task concerning the non-stationary thermal conductivity for a semi-infinite dielectric layer, when the plane electromagnetic wave is incident on its surface. For the wave, the power surface distribution is assumed to be known. The basic requirement, specific to microwave heating plants, is temperature field uniformity for the whole volume of processed material or some of its parts. In order to obtain uniform microwave heating of the object, we used a multi-element radiating system, located above its surface. The experimental results show that multi-element radiator systems allow us to obtain a more uniform temperature distribution, compared with single radiators.

articleTitle: Investigation of field distribution in open resonators using three-coordinate scanner
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A computer-aided experimental stand, allowing the reception of the field distribution pattern, with large resolution, in open resonant structures and in free space, for the investigation of the structure of field distributions in the near-field zone of antennas is developed. In addition, by using the stand, it is possible to carry out research into the spectral and power performance of resonant systems.

articleTitle: A fuzzy-neural approach for the characterisation of the active microwave devices
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Artificial neural networks are emerging as a powerful technology for RF and microwave characterization, modeling, and design. A neural modeler helps us to immediately start developing neural models for RF/microwave components and circuits and helps to provide neural models for our simulators. In this study, a novel fuzzy neural network structure is used for behavior of an active microwave device. Here, the device is modeled by a black box whose small signal and noise parameters are evaluated through a fuzzy clustering neural network based upon the fitting of both of these parameters.

articleTitle: High-efficiency peniotron 915 MHz for technological applications
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented here are the results of a computer optimized design of a 915 MHz peniotron (including simulation of the electron-optic system) with the following parameters: output power - 15 kW, accelerating voltage - 10.3 kV, maximal efficiency - 80%.

articleTitle: Pin-attenuator on waveguide-slot line
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The characteristics of a pin-attenuator on a slotted-waveguide line, operating in the upper part of the cm-band, are presented. In the band of more than 3 GHz, an attenuator with two 2A5135 diodes provides an attenuation adjustment of up to 45 dB when the VSWR is no more than 2.2. While the attenuation adjustment is within 0-30 dB, the phase change is no more than 26/spl deg/.

articleTitle: Pulse radiation of tapered slot antenna array
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Pulse radiation of tapered slot antenna array was analyzed. The main features of pulse summing from antenna arrays was shown. The possibility of beam control with time delay (analog of phased array for pulses) was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Dual-frequency turnstile antenna with impedance elements
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented here are the results of research of radiation characteristics and input resistances of dual-frequency dipole turnstile antenna using the method of equivalent long line and integral equations. The example of a turnstile array antenna consisting of four vibrators with impedance elements is shown.

articleTitle: Thin wide-band radio absorbing coatings
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The difficulty of creation of a broadband thin absorptive coating consists in the simultaneous fulfillment of two conditions in a broad frequency band: minor reflection of a wave dropping from free space on the leading edge of the coating; and strong wave absorption inside the coating layer. The problems of synthesis of thin coatings are analysed mathematically. The results indicate that the physically solid distributions of inductivity in the depth of the coating ensure low values of reflection coefficient in a broad frequency band.

articleTitle: Fractal signals sorting against different disturbing signals
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Recent changes in the electromagnetic environment are bound up with the introduction of high-power sources of electromagnetic radiation and this has led to transmitted data distortion Consequently the problem of creating antijamming signals for communication systems has become very urgent. Considered in this paper are fractal spread-spectrum signals (FSS), and their interference immunity against different disturbing signals is calculated.

articleTitle: The optimization of radiation performance of coaxial collinear antennas with series feeding dividers
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of investigating a three-element coaxial-collinear cophased antenna with a series feeding divider are presented. It is shown that these antennas can be optimized to attain a maximum directivity or a quasi-cosecant pattern.

articleTitle: Rigorous calculation of cross polarization radiation of an open-ended circular waveguide
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Cross-polarization characteristics for both a one-mode open-ended circular waveguide and a multimode one with a TM/sub 11/ mode excitation have been calculated on the basis of the rigorous Wainstein theory. The optimal waveguide diameter ensuring the minimal level of cross-polarization has been determined.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic field structure in waveguiding stick of strip metal-dielectric waveguide with losses
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A mathematical model of the field distribution in a metal-dielectric strip waveguide (MDSW) has been designed, taking into account the loss. Field distributions in MDSW are compared with well-known results.

articleTitle: Research of the WPT system with transmitting antenna having star-shaped aperture
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Opportunities of decreasing of near sidelobes level in flat transmitting antennas with star-shaped aperture are investigated. Change from circular aperture to star-shaped aperture with the same area is accompanied by insignificant narrowing of the main lobe of electromagnetic field angular distribution in the vicinity of receiving antenna. The first sidelobe level can be reduced from -17 dB in the case of usual circular aperture down to -30 dB and more at the star-shaped aperture. Unfortunately, the calculations do not confirm expected increase of power transfer ratio (PTR) between transmitting and receiving antennas. The physical explanation of this fact is given.

articleTitle: Influence of initial profile approximation on volt-amp diagrams of tunnel-resonance diode
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An analysis of the influence of barrier approximation and well shapes of a resonant tunneling diode (RTD) on its I-V characteristics was performed. It was shown that results are most sensitive to the approximation of a barrier potential on the heterojunction interface.

articleTitle: 0.18 /spl mu/m CMOS LNA and mixer for wireless LAN applications
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A low noise amplifier (LNA) and mixer for 5.15-5.825 GHz wireless local area network (LAN) applications were designed and fabricated in 0.18 /spl mu/m CMOS technology. The newly proposed topologies are described. Simulation results for the LNA are: noise figure (NF) of 1.72 dB, power gain of 18.6 dB, and input 1-dB compression point (P/sub -1dB/) of -15.6 dBm. Simulation results for the mixer are: power conversion gain of 7.8 dB, input 3/sup rd/-order intercept point (IP3) of 6.6 dBm, input P/sub -1dB/ of -3.5 dBm, and single side-band NF of 7.1 dB.

articleTitle: Microstrip filter with adjustable coupling compensation for receiver-indicator of GLONASS+GPS
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of miniaturization of microstrip filters with a narrow passband is offered. The suggested method allows controlling the main electrical filter characteristics and optimising its dimensions simply.

articleTitle: Radiometric imaging for concealed weapon detection
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described here is the opportunity of concealed weapon detection using a radiometric system. The single-channel passive imaging system, which operated in the W-band allows the detection and recognition of metal and plastic subjects under clothes on a human body.

articleTitle: Synthesis and generation of fractal information signals
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An experimental investigation of the synthesis and generation of fractal information signals is undertaken. The spectral characteristics of the transmitted fractal signals are measured experimentally. The signal spectra are shown to have self-similar characters.

articleTitle: Optimization of conical spiral antenna geometry by required radiation pattern criterion
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The investigation results of conical spiral antenna radiation characteristics are presented. An exponential spiral winding law for conical antennas providing the given radiation mode is proposed on the basis of a local equivalence principle. A comparison of the conical spiral antennas radiation characteristics with the well-known spiral winding laws (equiangular, Archimedian) is carried out.

articleTitle: Low loss phase shifter based on piezocontrolled dielectric composite
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A "high-/spl epsiv/ dielectric-air slot" layered sandwich composite is used for fast tunable low loss phase shifters. This composite effective dielectric constant /spl epsiv//sub ef/ is controlled by a modern fast actuator that changes the width of the air slot. Using the highest quality microwave dielectrics, it is possible to realize a low loss phase shifter in the microwave and mm-wave range.

articleTitle: Subsurface penetrating radars
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Subsurface penetrating radars (SPR) are designed for subsurface monitoring and are able to execute detection, location determination and diagnosis of subsurface areas and objects at a new quality standard level. Basic problems regarding the design of such radars are examined in this paper. They are: the choice of frequency band for radio probing and the type of probing signal, information acquisition strategy, aperture generating method, estimation of resolution, dynamic range and capabilities of the system; algorithm design for radar imaging with respect to specific character of super wide band probing signal; system components design, including antenna, transmitting and receiving modules, information processing and screening module.

articleTitle: Microwave techniques for gas-and-oil producing industry
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problems of development of microwave techniques for the gas-and-oil production industry are considered. The physical substance of realized microwave technological processes is briefly argued. The classification of microwave techniques being used in gas-and-oil producing industry is described, basic requirements are given, and the economic and ecological aspects of their application are noted.

articleTitle: Synthesis of compact impedance buffers on the basis of tapered stubs
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Optimal designs of stepped real impedance transformers (IT) with tapered stubs (NS) are presented. Comparative analysis of matching band, reflection coefficient in band and length of stepped IT with NS and uniform stubs (US) is made. It was shown that considered designs have lesser reflection coefficient in matching band and, which is more important, the length of NS less than length of US.

articleTitle: Experimental simulation of power performances of tyre pyrolysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Microwave techniques for tyre treatment possesses a number of advantages: reduced treatment time, reduced temperature conditions, high dynamics of temperature control. The microwave effect is more efficient, as against HF-heating (wavelengths 1 - 100 m). The microwave treatment has a high thermal action process speed. It is much higher than HF heating due to the use of electromagnetic field energy. Results of the research show that a power installation for tyre pyrolysis should provide an energy density not less than 30-50 W/cm/sup 2/. In order to keep the efficiency maximal, it is necessary to remove dross from the rubber surface.

articleTitle: Low power level microwave stabilizer with a wide dynamic range
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A low power level microwave stabilizer with a wide dynamic range has been designed. Silicon Schottky diodes are used in the limiter module. The device structure is considerably simplified compared to the prototype.

articleTitle: Microstrip filters based on hairpin resonators with a stepped change of conductor width
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The quality factor of microstrip filters based on oppositely directed hairpin microstrip resonators with a step of strip width is considered. The sections with quantity of resonators from two up to six are investigated. It is shown that the quality factor of the filter is substantially determined by quantity of resonators used in its manufacturing.

articleTitle: Introduction evaluation of synchronization signals quality on digital transmission networks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In order to solve the problem of synchronization in transmission networks, it is necessary to measure reference signal parameters and estimate their stability. This paper considers the basic principles of measurement of clock signal parameters in SDH transport networks.

articleTitle: One-dimensional digital filtering technique for increase of TV-image quality
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We analyzed the quality of a TV image subjected to one-dimensional filtering, the influence of input signal/noise ratio and operation threshold of one-dimensional digital filter on the output signal/noise ratio, as well as the influence of operation threshold on useful signal distortion.

articleTitle: Millimeter-range parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper the results of researching an uncooled parametric low noise amplifier intended as an input stage for 60-65 GHz input devices are given. Electrodynamic characteristics of the oscillatory system using an SBD mounting unit based coaxial waveguide for idle frequency signal circuits are investigated. Experimental results of testing amplifier prototypes executed on unpackaged SBD are shown. Amplification factor amounted to 15 dB, with noise temperature of 550-600 K.

articleTitle: Radiotelescopes for observation of /spl mu/S pulsations of solar radiation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Radio telescopes for the registration of solar radio emission at centimeter and meter wavelengths are described. On the basis of observations, the properties of radio bursts are determined and the probable nature of their origin is discussed.

articleTitle: Solid-state coherent-pulse radars for radiomagnetic imaging systems
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the development and investigations of a solid-state coherent-pulsing radar station, operating in the short wave part of the mm-wave range (SW MMR), for complicated object recognition are presented. The information gathering possibilities of such radar is not worse than that of optical facilities.

articleTitle: Reduction of mutual coupling between the elements of active phase array using compensation method and control adaptation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered are L- and S-band active phase arrays, consisting of strip-line radiators and active elements. In this paper, we state measures for the reduction of mutual coupling between radiators at scanning by the introduction of compensating coupling elements into the radiator feed systems, as well as by the adaptation of APAA control.

articleTitle: The ATDP suite structure for adaptive testing of electronic system states
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The structure and features of the adaptive testing and data processing software suite (ATDP suite) are presented. It is applied for the dynamic characteristics restoration, from experimental time series, of nonlinear and unstable electronic systems. The basic methods realized in the ATDP suite are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Devices for mm-wave therapy. Modern tendencies of design
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes the trends for further development of medical mm-wave equipment, in order to take account of patient personality and providing higher efficiency of mm-wave therapy. The basic principles of design of mm-wave therapy devices are analyzed.

articleTitle: Features of stationary electric and magnetic fields in fractal electrodynamic structures
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Stationary electric fields for a fractal system of charged strings and for a fractal current are found. We consider linear structures of fractal objects having a Cantor set in their cross-section.

articleTitle: Using of berlox ceramics in microwave technology
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Relative characteristics of different types of ceramics used in microwave engineering are presented. Beryllium oxide ceramics applications are determined by analysis of material requirements. The properties of ceramics and samples of products mostly often used in the microwave engineering produced at the factory are reported.

articleTitle: Theoretical game estimation of cipher immunity in telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper is the game theory synthesis of telecommunication systems under conditions of a conflict situation between the system operator (cryptographer) and cryptology analyzer. Game cost and optimal (minimax) randomized strategies have been found. The entropy estimation of cipher immunity has been used.

articleTitle: Low-resistance ohmic contact to n-GaAs
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A multi-layered AuGe-Ti-TiN-Ti-Au metallization has been researched to develop a low-resistance ohmic contact to n-GaAs. The value of the obtained specific contact resistance was (4.1+5.6)/spl times/10/sup -7/ ohm/spl middot/cm and retained its stability after a five-hour treatment at 300/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Determination of radio-sources angular data using antenna hardware
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: To raise accuracy of measurements of angular coordinates of radiosources by a monostatic antenna, it is necessary to use information that both parameters of a received signal and the form of a diagram of the direction of an antenna (apparatus function) contain. The result of experimental determination of azimuth of space radio sources with the use of information about the form of a diagram of direction of an antenna for the radiotelescope RT-70 are given.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic peniotron system for industrial applications
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the analysis and computer-aided simulation of an optoelectronic system shaping a high-perveance tubular electron flow for a commercially applied peniotron (f=915 MHz), operating at the first gyroharmonic, and a low voltage of - 10 kV, are presented.

articleTitle: Objects imagery using microwave single-position radar
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The investigation results of imaging processes in single-position radar with space-time scanning are discussed in this paper. The possibility of visualisation of the geometrical shape of objects has been evaluated after results of simulation of space-time scanning processes, scattering processes, as well as coherent signal processing.

articleTitle: Processing characteristics of ion-chemical etching of single-crystal silicon by complex discharge plasma
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of technological tests of the designed and manufactured discharge device. It is intended for plasma etching of materials, used in microelectronics. Reactive particles, formed in a complex (SHF and LF field) discharge, influence upon the material surface, which is the main feature of the treatment process. The experimental results demonstrated high quantitative and qualitative performances of the etching processes (in particular monocrystalline silicon etching) realized in the designed discharge device.

articleTitle: Short spiral doublet
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered is a doublet with spiral arms of small diameter and small pitch. Such a doublet provides considerable shortening. Impedance properties of such a vibrator are compared with those of a linear vibrator.

articleTitle: Electrophysical monitoring of stress state and its correction by influence of low-intensive MM-radiation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper it is shown that EHF therapy allows one to effectively activate the corresponding adaptive reactions of a human organism in conditions of deep stress by means of low intensity MM-wave radiation at Ka-band. Electropunctural monitoring allows one to indicate and control all stages of the process.

articleTitle: Magnetooptic diffraction spectrum analyser of microwave signal
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A wide-band magnetooptic spectrum analyser for microwave signals, operating within the frequency band of 1-10 GHz, is designed. Operation of this device is based on Bragg diffraction of optical guided waves (OGW) by magnetostatic waves (MSW), excited in yttrium iron garnet films.

articleTitle: Influence of microwave and MM-wave electromagnetic fields on biological objects
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We studied the influence of electromagnetic fields on biological objects. The paper presents results of research concerning the influence of an electromagnetic field on different seeds.

articleTitle: Extreme automaton for antenna pointing
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of creation of step-by-step system for antenna pointing on unstable geostationary artificial satellites.

articleTitle: TWT with combined gyroresonance-gyroton type of interaction of E/sub 11/ and H/sub 11/ mode waves with helical electron beam in corrugated waveguide
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper describes the research into a combined gyroresonance-gyroton mechanism of interaction between a large-orbit helical electron beam and rotating E/sub 11/ and H/sub 11/ mode waves in a circular corrugated waveguide. The research has shown the possibility of designing highly-efficient TWTs, offering an efficiency of about 78%. At the same time, both transverse and longitudinal energy is tapped from an electron beam.

articleTitle: Quartz fiberguides for laser and medical applications, obtained by microwave plasma-chemical deposition from gas phase
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Quartz-quartz lightguides with fluorine cladding and pure silica glass core for the transmission of high power UV (/spl lambda/=0.308 /spl mu/m) and IR (/spl lambda/=1.06 /spl mu/m) laser radiation were produced by a microwave plasmochemical deposition method at low pressure.

articleTitle: Power performance of an inclined slots system in a narrow wall of a rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: At present a wider use as radiators of inclined slots made in the narrow wall of a waveguide is restricted by the absence of the practically applicable algorithm for the calculation of their electrodynamic performance. The purpose of the present work is to define the mutual conductivity of inclined slots in the narrow wall of the rectangular waveguide. A method of computing the power performance of a system of inclined slots cut in the narrow wall and penetrating its wider wall is suggested.

articleTitle: Investigation of nonequilibrium component of human microwave radiation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper are the results of investigations, from three respondents, of microwave nonequilibrium radiation within the 53-78 GHz band. Nonequilibrium radiation is a perspective for diagnostics of a living organism's state.

articleTitle: Scalar network analyzer for 3 mm wavelength
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A scalar network analyzer for the frequency range 78.33 - 118.1 GHz is presented. The analyzer functioning principles and experimental results are also presented.

articleTitle: New application of apparatus for local microwave hyperthermia of prostate ALMGP-01
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes the design of a hardware-software technique and principles permitting the use of an ALMGP-01 apparatus for complex treatment of prostatitis by means of microwave heating, hydraulic heating and hydromechanical massaging. The method is implemented in several samples, the medical trials are carried out, and positive results are obtained.

articleTitle: Determination of phase residual deviation level in the communication bus
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of method of definition of a level of spurious phase deviation by method of digital processing is submitted. The features of application of a method are determined. The requirements for measuring system are found and the outcomes of calculations are adduced.

articleTitle: Proposals for improving of frequency support of decameter radio-communication
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown, that ensuring stable long-distance communication is possible only at specified frequencies, which are chosen taking into account the recommendations of the skywave service. The creation of such service in Ukraine is necessary.

articleTitle: Concentrated interference control in the open analog radio channels
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: At present along with digital VHF communication systems, analog radio channels are widely used. At present the problem of antijamming is critical. The noise source is spurious emission from CATV systems, private VHF networks, personal extenders, etc. This paper is devoted to a problem of antijamming.

articleTitle: A cathode-driven CFA gain increase
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The causes of the cathode-driven CFA's (double-row amplitron in particular) gain restriction are analyzed. It has been established that one of the reasons for this is a predominant electron stream control by the RF field of the anode delay line while the cathode input signal is disregarded. To remedy this drawback, double-row CFA designs are suggested having one or two axially shifted bunching spaces which contain a cathode delay line only. Thus a condition for an electron stream bunching under the influence of the input signal without disturbance from the anode structure RF field is ensured.

articleTitle: Modelling of light passing in photon crystals
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The numerical modeling of light propagation in a 2D photonic crystal (PC) optical fiber is carried out using the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method. Along with results of this modeling, the Maxwell's equation for the case of PCs are derived.

articleTitle: Electrically long radiating systems based on hybrid structures
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental results of investigating a radiating system based on a hybrid structure are presented. This system includes a dielectric image guide and an electrically long microstrip radiator. The structure of near zone fields is investigated. The influence of the principal parameters of the microstrip on characteristics of the radiating system is established.

articleTitle: Amplification of a short electromagnetic pulse propagating through an electron beam
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The amplification of a short electromagnetic pulse propagating through a stationary electron pulse with group velocity different from that of the translational electron velocity has been researched. It has been shown that due to the constant feeding of the backfront of an electromagnetic pulse by nonmodulated electrons the peak pulse amplitude may substantially exceed levels corresponding to the saturation level for the amplification of CW signals.

articleTitle: The full-wave simulation of airplane antennas of sea parameters radar meter
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes the results of full-wave computer simulations of wire antennas used in seaplane sea disturbance measurement radar systems. A quarter wave dipole and two variants of wire antenna were analysed. During the numerical analysis, the seaplane flight characteristics influence on the antenna parameters was taken into account.

articleTitle: Frequency properties of multiprobe microwave multimeters
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The report is devoted to the analysis of exactitude of multiprobe microwave multimeter algorithms in a range of operational frequencies, comparing the equidistant and non-equidistant arrangement of sensors. The analysis is produced on basis of variance and covariance matrix. The optimum technique of complex signals and tract parameters evaluation in microwave frequency band is developed.

articleTitle: Sets of driving oscillators with fast frequency switching
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Recently, multiple frequency oscillator units providing the switching of stable microwave signal sources have attracted considerable interest. These units provide a frequency switching rate below 5 /spl mu/s while retaining the parameters of an individual dielectric resonator (DR) stabilized microwave oscillator. These oscillator units use sharp suppression and excitation of self-induced oscillations in the oscillator circuit, in addition to a high-speed multichannel p-i-n switch (up to 10 channels).

articleTitle: Retrieval of fast processes distorted by integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We designed algorithms for fast process retrieval at the input of integrated circuits, based on Tikhonov's theory of ill-posed problems. This is necessary when the input signal change time is shorter than the integration time of the capacitance integrator.

articleTitle: Characterization of antenna for nHEB detector using electromagnetic calculation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Comprehensive 3D electromagnetic simulation of antenna structure for nHEB (normal-metal hot-electron bolometer) detector was conducted within 200-400 GHz frequency band. The simulation is based on Agilent HFSS software. The obtained results include S parameters and far field calculations, which could be used for evaluation of antenna optimal matching with both detector microstructure and incoming radiation. The Agilent HFSS software allows one to control convergence process, to calculate errors, and to improve accuracy if needed.

articleTitle: Effective irregular cavity BWO
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The description of model of coupled-cavity BWO is given and the results of optimization of irregular BWO on a coupled-cavity are submitted. In a cm-band the generators on irregular BWO can have electronic efficiency 50%, hybrid circuits of a BWO-TWT, 68%.

articleTitle: Wavetrains scattering by anisotropic composite absorbing layer with metal-dielectric substrate
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of wave beam scattering from a composite anisotropic absorbing layer on a metal cladding is considered. Beam transformation is investigated and the possibility of the scattered wave beam characteristics control by means of layer material parameter changes is validated.

articleTitle: Application of up-to-date materials and microelectronic technology in production of microwave and optical telecommunications equipment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of many years' experience in the field of using different materials and microelectronic technologies for the production of microwave and optoelectronics devices for telecommunication equipment. Special attention is paid to A/sub 3/B/sub 5/ semiconductor materials and multilayer film structures as the basis of these devices. The experience of perspective ion technology applications is considered for the forming of microelectronic devices for microwave and optical wavebands.

articleTitle: Phenomenon of anomalous diffraction radiation in the metal-dielectric grating
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Conditions for occurrences of a diffraction radiation (DR) exclusively into the dielectric of metal-dielectric grating (we have named this phenomenon an anomalous DR or ADR) are shown and analyzed. Contrary to the Cerenkov radiation, an ADR may occur at ultra low electron velocities (/spl beta//spl Lt/1//spl radic//spl epsi/). Electromagnetic field, energy density and other characteristics of the ADR are found as the exact solution of the strict mathematical task. A number of ADR characteristics have been calculated. The use of the ADR phenomenon is suggested for the miniaturization of diffraction electronic devices, e.g. in the design of semiconductor oscillators.

articleTitle: Transceiving microwave modules for telecommunication equipment of mm-waveband
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the results of experimental design of transceiver units for mm-wave radio-relay communication systems. Due to the demands of increased communication systems capacity, the mm-waveband has become widely used because of its bandwidth, good performance in poor meteorological conditions (rain, snow, dust and fog), interference immunity and small overall dimensions and weight. At present mm-wave communication equipment and facilities are in the development stage all over the world. In order to demonstrate the completeness of mm-wave technology, 38-94 GHz transceiver units for communication systems designed by Research Institute Orion, Kyiv, are described. Specialists from Research Institute Orion developed the following advanced communication equipment using proper solid-state components (S.P. Rakitin et al, 10th Int. Conf. Microwave and Telecom. Tech., pp. 33-36, 2000): transceiver units for mm-wave radio-relay stations (RRS) with high-speed data transmission; transceiver units for mm-wave radio-relay systems of high quality video-data transmission (reporting systems).

articleTitle: Metal reflectivity investigation at 110-200 GHz
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Reflectivity investigations were directed at high reflection metals like silver, copper, gold and aluminium to get mirrors with minimum possible reflection losses and on real metals and alloys which are widely used in high power electronics like stainless steel, titanium, brass and so on. The mm-wave range is a specific range because just in this range the skin-layer of metals may be higher as well as lower than the value of roughness for the main types of mechanical treatment. So it is expected that there must be a strong dependence of the reflection losses versus the roughness. This was confirmed by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Wideband frequency synthesizer of L-S bands with small tuning step and low level of phase noises
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the results of design and production of a low-noise frequency synthesizer in 1630-2730 MHz frequency range with 0.125 MHz step size for satellite communication up-converters.

articleTitle: Wideband signals passage in the active phase antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The passage of wideband signals in a transmitting active phased antenna array (APAA) is considered on the basis of a spectral approach. For the case of broadband phase-shifters, the variation of antenna array parameters is established. Demonstrated here is a decrease of received signal level with increase of frequency band occupied by the signal.

articleTitle: Whispering gallery oscillations in semiconductor magnetized sphere
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The research technique of eigen oscillations is shown for a gyrotropic sphere. The dispersion equation of "whispering gallery" oscillations was obtained for a semiconducting magnetized sphere.

articleTitle: Method of scanning near-field optical lithography
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A contact scanning near-field optical lithography method has been developed to enable fabrication of different nanoelements; (metal, dielectric, etched in surface or its combinations) on the various surfaces (metal, dielectric, light- and heavy doped semiconductors). The method involves interaction of heated probe of scanning near-field optical microscope with two-layer coating, followed by pattern transfer onto sample surface. The software for creation of different nanoelements; is developed. The nanoelements; with characteristic dimensions of about 50 nm are fabricated.

articleTitle: Topological synthesis of 96-channel PAA exciter on balanced E-dividers
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Balanced E-divider is developed; its weight and size are much less than weight and sizes of dividers based on H-bridges. The basic characteristics of given waveguide dividers are more uniform and exact than similar characteristics of bridges.

articleTitle: Controlled power divider on the basis of thin-film ferroelectric elements
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A construction of ferroelectric thin film controllable microwave power divider is presented. The X-band power divider has exhibited continuous redirection of input microwave power for each of two outputs from -3 dB to -35 dB.

articleTitle: Distinctive features of a strip electron beam shaping in a power resonance mm wave amplifier
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of computer simulation of 3D electron-optical and magnetic systems forming a broad 0.4/spl times/14 mm/sup 2/ cross-section for a power resonance 8-mm wave amplifier with an open electrodynamic system are presented. The influence of the magnetic field inhomogeneity on the character of beam shaping and conditions for its best transfer (96.3%) to the collector are shown. Recommendations on decreasing the beam losses are given.

articleTitle: HF complex dielectric permeability of salines aqueous solutions
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental characteristics of the high frequency permittivity dispersion of aqueous salt solutions of different concentrations are adduced. The permittivity and loss dependence on NaCl/H/sub 2/O solution concentration is analyzed.

articleTitle: Conditioner of 3-cm probing and heterodyne signals for radar stations
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The functional diagram of construction of the broadband former for probing and heterodyne signals of coherent radar on the basis of frequency synthesizers is given. Its brief characteristics are given.

articleTitle: High-Q TE/sub 01p/-resonator for dielectric permeability measuring
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A theory of the TE/sub 01p/-resonator method of measurement of dielectric permittivity of materials with high losses, like a solution of biomolecules, is developed. A ring grating decreased the Q-factor of the TE/sub 01p/-resonator, and thus decreases the method's measurement errors.

articleTitle: Rectennas alternative design for efficient systems of wireless power transmission
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: To attain the maximum intercept efficiency, the amplitude distribution along the rectenna's aperture should be significantly non-uniform. But the increase in the intercept efficiency results in a considerably large decrease in the rectification and collection efficiency. An effort to resolve the contradiction between the intercept efficiency and the decrease in the rectification and collection efficiency prompted an idea of designing a wireless power transmission (WPT) system with a uniform amplitude field distribution over the rectenna aperture. The aim of this work consists in checking the validity of this idea. Synthesis of the exciting field, ensuring the closest to the uniform amplitude distribution over the rectenna's aperture, is performed.

articleTitle: Transceiver antennas for state identification transponder
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the results of developing antenna systems (AE) for a prospective aircraft onboard state identification transponder (SIT). The AE of an onboard SIT channel consists of a number of antennas. The whole of the AE patterns covers virtually all of the space around the aircraft. The need to improve individual antennas, as well as their onboard set as a whole is determined by the following. Large sizes of antennas and their protective enclosures prominent above the aircraft body do not improve aerodynamic and electromagnetic qualities of the aircraft. The available operating band provides only for the domestic SIT channels, while auxiliary antennas are required for the international SIT. The development of an AE that is free from the drawbacks listed above and which provides both domestic and foreign SIT operation is described in this paper.

articleTitle: Cellular television - a high technology of broadband wireless access
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of broadband wireless access, on the basis of cellular television (CTV) equipment, is given as an analogue to the LMDS and MWS equipment. The technical-economical peculiarities and social aspects of CTV implementation are noted. The questions of interaction of CTV with the Russian information systems, electronic commerce systems and security systems are observed.

articleTitle: Image restoration in the near-field optic and UHF microscopy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Significant enhancement of resolution in the scanning near-field optical microscopy (SNOM) and in the microwave subsurface imaging (MSI) is achieved by deconvolution of measured 2-D images using Tikhonov's method. This method makes it possible to obtain much better sharpness of images.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic system with periodic structure
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper contains the results of experimental investigations of the electrodynamic system, that consists of metal tube with inner periodic structure, under different excitations. As a result, colour 3D images of spectral characteristics were obtained, and the Q-factor values were calculated for excited oscillation types.

articleTitle: Forced oscillations in nonlinear electron-wave systems of O-type. Simulation and analysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The theoretical investigation of the amplification and locking processes in the multidimensional O-type electron wave system has been carried out. The interaction space consists of stages with the resonance and nonresonance type of interaction between the electron beam and RF field. The analysis is carried out within the framework of a nonlinear multidimensional model of electron-wave interaction. The main attention is given to consideration of the system characteristics for powerful signals.

articleTitle: Experimental and theoretic research of electron motion in MPFS
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Conditions for the electron flow motion shaping in a magnet periodic focusing system (MPFS) flowing space have been theoretically and experimentally researched in this paper. A periodical trajectory of the electron flow, as well as noise radiation in the MM-wave range have been experimentally observed. Electron behavior in a model comprising a periodic series of plane magnets has been theoretically analyzed.

articleTitle: Metering microwave synthesizer for near-field microscopy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A frequency synthesizer for a microwave microscope is a programmed source of high-stability oscillations, designed to be used as a master oscillator in precision near-field measurements within the 1 - 20 GHz range of frequencies. The operating principles and specifications of the synthesizer are detailed.

articleTitle: Microstrip GaAs mm-wave generator with electronic frequency tuning
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes a microstrip GaAs mm-wave generator with electronic frequency tuning. Its output power is approximately 20 mW between the limits of 53 and 60 GHz. The frequency tuning band reaches 2 GHz for decreasing output power down to 10 mW.

articleTitle: Microwave probe based on resonance section of pair line
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in the paper is the influence of gorge non-linear effects on the operation of a plasma resonance microwave probe based on the resonance section of a pair line, both theoretically and experimentally. It is shown that such a probe (in non-linear mode) can be used for measurement of plasma density, as well as plasma temperature. Resonance probes, used for plasma diagnostics are very sensitive even to minor changes in media parameters. Shifting and expanding of the resonance curve is the main data source in such sensors. The probe should introduce minimal perturbations into the surrounding plasma, though these perturbations can also be used for diagnostics. Described in this paper is a plasma resonance microwave probe based on the resonance section of a pair line. Even at a comparatively low exciting signal, non-linear effects appear. The authors have developed a non-linear theory of resonance microwave probes based on the resonance section of a pair line, and compared theoretical calculations with experimental results. It is shown that the non-linear mode can be used successfully for measurement of plasma density, as well as plasma temperature. The plasma density and temperature data, obtained by means of the microwave sensor under consideration, agrees well with the measurement results obtained using traditional single and double probes.

articleTitle: Silicon Taiga [software development partnership]
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: At present, it is broadly recognized that Russia can be successfully presented on the world arena not only as a raw materials supplier but also as an IT and high-tech software solutions developer and provider. Russian software development companies can play an important role in the world market. Thus, high-tech software solutions can become a niche for Russia, and its competitive advantage in the global market. To this end, the non-profit partnership "Silicon Taiga" was established to implement projects aimed at promotion of innovative software solutions in the world market.

articleTitle: Systems of wireless broadband access
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper observes the variety of broadband wireless access systems (BWA systems). The view focus is on fixed access systems, used to solve the "last mile" problem. The purpose of BWA systems were noted, along with their services, structural properties, basic technical characteristics and equipment arrays. A comparative system analysis was carried out.

articleTitle: Photonic band-gap structures application in designing tunable microwave filters
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of developing PBG-based microwave filters in waveguides with various filling structures is examined. An experimental model of a microwave filter tunable by an external magnetic field is produced.

articleTitle: Tunable delay line based on quadrature bridges
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of tunable delay line (TDL) version realization consisting of two cascaded 3-dB quadrature bridges and tuned by capacitors is provided. The offered structure is simple for realization and consists of a minimum amount of elements. The synthesis method of such a device is given.

articleTitle: On the applicability of the traditional perturbation method in the theory of an O-type longtime interaction resonance oscillator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper points to the fact that the well-known approximate analytical theory of electron motion in the field of a retarded high-frequency wave is based on the assumption that the parameter of motion nonlinearity is small and appears to have an applicability which is insufficient to describe the electron beam dynamics in the mode of the most efficient energy interchange with the wave. Since the problem of electron motion in the wave field is a component part of the theory of the O-type oscillator with a long-time interaction, fundamental difficulties occur in the analytical description of the oscillator dynamics. It also poses a problem if such a theory is applicable for the description of the oscillator in the mode of a high-efficiency energy exchange between the electron beam and the wave. The present work considers the above issue and leads to a conclusion that such a theory is applicable, however, it does not cover high-efficiency modes.

articleTitle: Phase electron selection at orthoclinotron effect
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper attempts to explain the effect of increasing the interaction power of the electron beam and HF-field in O-type devices, with a small deviation of the direction of the focused finite magnetic field from the direction of the spatial field harmonic propagation by the phase electron selection realized by the transversal horizontal field component.

articleTitle: Low-noise 10 mW amplifier in 35-37 GHz band
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Ensuring high output power (10 mW) of a low-noise amplifier is an actual task for many applications. This paper presents the results of experimental research for such an amplifier in the mm-wave band.

articleTitle: Temperature influence on the operation of wideband mm-wave GaAs oscillator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the results of experimental research for a rectangular-coaxial broadband mm-wave GaAs-Gunn oscillator in the temperature range between -50/spl deg/C and +100/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Waveguide ferrite polarizer of 3-cm waveband
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The parameters of a 3-cm range waveguide ferrite polarizer are measured in this work. This polarizer is a section of a circular waveguide with a rectangular ferrite plate. A polarization diagram and frequency characteristics of the polarizer are presented.

articleTitle: Performance of a parabolic cylindrical antenna with an array shaping flat-topped element patterns
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The calculated radiation patterns and gain of a parabolic cylinder excited by a linear array shaping the flat-topped element patterns are presented. It is shown that such an antenna provides better scanning performance with a smaller number of controlled elements and smaller overall antenna dimensions in comparison with recently proposed focus-based hybrid antennas.

articleTitle: Algorithm of adaptive spatial signal division for low-element antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The approach ensures the problem solution of two non-Gaussian signals division under conditions of the complete a priori uncertainty as to the signal parameters and antenna array characteristics.

articleTitle: Problems of development of microwave protection equipment for radar and telecommunication
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The modern status and prospects of development of microwave protection equipment (PE) for radar and radiocommunications are considered. Fields of application, main types of PE, problems in meeting modern specifications and perspectives on technical decisions are shown. Russian domestic schools under the direction of Prof. I.V. Lebedev have played a special role in PE development.

articleTitle: Calculation of drain-to-gate characteristics of single-electron structures
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The two-dimensional numerical models of one- and two-island single-electron structures are modified to calculate their drain-to-gate characteristics. A comparison with experimental data is given for a transistor.

articleTitle: Advanced telecommunication technologies of mm-wave band
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the features of mm-wave telecommunication systems, including traditional radio-relay and satellite systems, as well as a number of new systems, based on high altitude platforms, optical fiber-radio channel junctions and broadband radio-access.

articleTitle: Development of the numerical code for researching a virtual cathode in a group ion accelerator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Primary results of developing a numerical electromagnetic code for researching a virtual cathode in the presence of plasma are presented. These results are a part of Project 1569 titled 'development of the group ion accelerator based on a plasma vircator and periodic magnetic field' executed under an agreement with the Science and Technology Center of Ukraine. The description of an algorithm for a numerical simulation of a virtual cathode in a cylindrical drift chamber is adduced. The algorithm is implemented through a set of programs written in the C++ language. Numerical calculations were made for the upgraded Agat experimental facility; the results are presented in graphical form.

articleTitle: Compact two-component microstrip magnetic field sensor
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A diminutive microstrip sensor with anisotropic magnetic films, which is capable of measuring two components of the magnetic field with a high accuracy, is developed. The structure of the sensor consists of two quarter-wave resonators positioned orthogonal to each other.

articleTitle: Electron movement in the Motz undulator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Electron motion in an undulator magnetic field formed by straight magnets with alternating polarity placed in parallel is studied in this work. In the mathematical model the magnets are simulated as dipoles. It is shown with a high degree of accuracy that the dipole field is chaotic, which causes frequent shifts in the direction of the electron motion and occurrences of braking radiation. The well-known Ginsburg formulas were used.

articleTitle: Fields and structure of a nonequilibrium discharge formed by a microwave plasmatron
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper deals with the features of a microwave EM field and discharge structure in a plasma flame formed by the "Torche A Injection Axiale" (TIA) (J. Jonkers et al, Spectrochim. Acta., vol. B 51, p. 1385, 1996). The outline of physical processes in these microwave discharges is discussed.

articleTitle: LNA - active bandpass filter for 465 MHz
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We designed a LNA, which has the structure and characteristics of an active bandpass filter. The NF is equal to 0.8 dB in the frequency band from 460 to 470 MHz at a gain factor of 21 dB and off-band rejection of more than 60 dB at the frequencies of 395 MHz and 535 MHz. The upper boundary of ICP linearity equals 15 dBm. Hybrid-integral LNA circuit has 30/spl times/18/spl times/9 mm/sup 3/ dimensions.

articleTitle: Low power limiter [FET amplifiers]
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present article introduces the results of designing a low power limiter for GaAs FET amplifiers. The possibility of obtaining minimal values for the noise factor is shown when matching circuits are optimized with regard to the limiter diode parasitic capacitance and when the amplifying transistor gate-source junction is used as a detector diode.

articleTitle: Microwave level gauge with weight smoothening of discrete error
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We consider a microwave level gauge for measuring the level of loose, fluid and paste-like substances inside various industrial reservoirs. Two dielectric resonators allow the reduction of the measurement error and improvement of the stability of the microwave generator's frequency modulation. A weighting method of processing the difference signal eliminates the discrete error inherent in such devices. The methodic component of the measurement error is analyzed.

articleTitle: On the possibility of spatial stratification of source density in radio objects
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A numerical processing of radiosource radiation intensities has been conducted using a previously suggested technique of detecting radial distributions of radiation sources according to the results of wide-aperture integral measurements of luminosities under the assumption of local symmetry.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic criterion of smoothness of a surface with roughness in the form of Gaussian grooves for E-waves
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We have obtained criterion of smoothness of a surface with roughness in the form of Gaussian grooves based on the black body theory for electromagnetic waves region and skin-effect theory. Groove profile geometries are expressed by wavelength (E-wave case).

articleTitle: LF oscillations excitation by the ion stream in high current relativistic electron beams
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The mechanisms of LF oscillation excitation by an ion stream moving in electrical fields of the spatial charge of relativistic electron beams are investigated. Frequencies of the ion LF oscillations are obtained. A physical picture of the excitation of the LF oscillation is described.

articleTitle: Principles of creation of MITRIS-based subscriber access system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper presents the basic principles of the creation of the backward channel, used in the MITRIS system.

articleTitle: Multi-purpose compact generator of high-voltage high-current nanosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper is a multipurpose compact high-voltage high current nanosecond pulse generator on the basis of a magnetic-cumulative generator (MCG). Results of powering of "fast" forming lines with liquid dielectric and reflex triodes are given.

articleTitle: Coaxial biconical cavity with dielectric cylinder in the break of central conductor
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented are the results of numerical calculations of the resonance frequency of H-mode azimuthally symmetric oscillations in a coaxial biconical cavity with a dielectric cylinder in the break of the central conductor. The effect of the break moving along the longitudinal axis of the cavity is studied.

articleTitle: Compact travelling wave resonator with slot coupling elements
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design features of traveling wave resonator with small-sized area of communication consisting of four inclined slots with phase shift practically independent of frequency, between signals, in 20 percentage bands are considered. The authors consider the analysis of a resonator.

articleTitle: Wave processes in an open waveguide with a metal-dielectric layer
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the linear self-consistent theory of an amplifier based on the Smith-Parsell effect is developed for a periodical metal structure in terms of metal-dielectric layer field and electron beam interaction. A dispersion equation has been obtained allowing for the analysis of the effect of the metal-dielectric layer exerted on the electromagnetic wave stimulation in such a structure. The electrodynamic amplification system has been experimentally investigated in the mm-wave range.

articleTitle: Phase stable driver amplifier
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents experimental results for a GaAs phase stable driver amplifier based on FETs with Schottky-barrier gates. Estimated and experimental characteristics of the amplifier are given.

articleTitle: Multi-beam antenna of short-range navigation system of a car
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The use of a multi-beam aerial in a collision avoidance system and short-range radio navigation system extends significantly the range of problems solved with the aid of an automatic control system and improves traffic safety. The aerial is a system assembly whose minimization and optimization are difficult. The herein-presented bifocal array-lens aerial lends itself readily to optimization and meets all requirements imposed. In this paper, we formulate and solve a number of problems on optimization of the given aerial.

articleTitle: Definition of material parameters of industrial thin-film samples [magnetodielectric and gyrotropic materials]
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analytical expression for the reflection factor of the waveguide wave diffraction on a T-shaped branching of a waveguide, the majority of which is completely filled with a thin-film ferrite medium (isotropic or anisotropic), is solved. The results of the calculation of the absolute value and phase of the reflection factor and wavelength, permittivity, and permeability of a sample are given.

articleTitle: Directional and polarization properties of a low-element conformal antenna built on an array of zigzag radiators
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problems of designing low-element antenna arrays from zigzag radiators arranged on conformal surfaces of the second order are discussed. The dependence of radiation features of the two-element array on the geometrical properties of radiators, as well as on geometrical parameters of a hyperbolic surface are presented.

articleTitle: New line of MITRIS system development
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper describes possibilities of using MITRIS system for the purpose of Internet providing, as well as for multiservice traffic transmission.

articleTitle: Hysteresis of reflection ratio at surface polariton excitation on conducting antiferromagnet boundary
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper deals with the theoretical investigation of the hysteresis effects and bistability states arising from the excitation of surface polaritons (SP) with the attenuated total reflection (ATR) technique at the nonlinear conducting antiferromagnet boundary. We focus on the investigation of the influence of the electron plasma frequency on the bistability initiation conditions.

articleTitle: Microwave filters and multichannel divider based on surface magnetostatic waves
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Consideration to an application of surface magnetostatic waves in ferrite films for the creation of microwave band-pass filters is given. Experimental samples of single-channel filter with insertion losses at the center frequency of less than 2.5 dB are discussed. The filter center frequency and bandwidth can both be tuned independently. Specifications of frequency channelizers are shown.

articleTitle: Cascading of microstrip filters based on resonators with stubs
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Selective properties of microstrip two-section filters based on hairpin resonators having irregular stubs are investigated as a function of design parameters. Parametric synthesis of filter conductor pattern corresponding to a given specific performance is developed. Considered are the filters formed by cascade connection of the two-section microstrip structures.

articleTitle: National telecommunication satellite of Ukraine. Problems of creation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Ukraine, as with any country in the world, feels the need for services such as telephone communications, data transmission, multiprogram TV, Internet and mobile communications. This paper presents a brief performance summary of the Ukrainian telecommunications market, as well as the conditions which led to the creation and launching of the Ukrainian national telecommunication satellite.

articleTitle: Random coding application in broadband communication systems
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the application of pseudorandom signals, generated by chaotic algorithms, as coding sequences for broadband systems with channel code division, operating in an interference environment.

articleTitle: CAD of 20 GHz hybrid sampling phase detector
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Several designs have been introduced to implement a microwave sampler. However, the approach to this issue has been almost completely empirical. This paper provides an effort to simulate an SPD (sampling phase detector) and illustrates the difficulties encountered in this process. The simulation and measurement of the constructed module, accompanied by a brief theoretical investigation give a new insight into the performance of the sampling device.

articleTitle: Subsurface imaging using spectral methods
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the spectral method of restoring of subsurface objects' geometry (bi-variate case). The method is based on the use of a convolution algorithm and measuring of spatial samples of the scattered electromagnetic field with consequent conversion into spatial frequencies domain. The numerical simulation of image restoration was carried out (for direct problem solution the FDTD method was used). The approach presented in this paper is the first stage of definition of electrophysical and geometrical parameters of subsurface objects, as it allows the narrowing of the class of restored objects and their parameters.

articleTitle: Strict electrodynamic simulation of Rotman lens
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The authors consider the application of a flat multibeam Rotman lens in feed systems of array antennas. Satisfactory results are obtained by strict electrodynamic modeling of the elementary case of similar devices that allows optimistic forecasts on the improvement of radio engineering characteristics of the proposed device.

articleTitle: Discrete diode microwave phase shifter
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of research, computer simulation and development of the discrete p-i-n diodes phase shifter (PS) in the centimetric wave band are represented. The selected buildup principle allows one to create a PS that passes pulsed microwave power up to the level 2-3 kW, with relative on-off time ratio 18 and commutation speed 1-2 /spl mu/s. The application of storage units in the control system allows us to optimize PS parameters to obtain high accuracy of setting of a phase discrete value and low loss of transmitted microwave power. Test results are given.

articleTitle: Creation of multiservice networks on the basis of ATM technology
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the design method for ATM-based multiservice networks, as well as the methods of service providing. An example of a network structure is given.

articleTitle: Numeric computation of proofness of inhomogeneous microstructure elements at the influence of power electromagnetic field [IC degradation]
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A procedure for the numerical calculation of the development of degradation processes in microstructure elements of integrated circuits by the action of electromagnetic fields is presented. The influence of conductive microstructure inhomogeneity parameters upon a threshold value of the electric intensity of an impinging electromagnetic wave is detected.

articleTitle: Using of advanced methods for express-diagnostics and control of medical process dynamics
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a new approach for express-diagnostics and control of medical process dynamics at different pathological and functional changes in human organisms. Clinical tests were conducted in order to fix the change of complex admittance parameters in bio-active points (BAP) during therapeutic procedures using mm-wave electromagnetic radiation.

articleTitle: Investigation of chaos, caused by awkward shaped signals in some non-commercial radioelectronic devices
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The EMC problem is gaining essential attention recently. The influence of external interference on the operation of a commercial receiver-amplifier section is investigated.

articleTitle: Some methods of enhancement using microwave technology and some natural and social factors
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper first gives a general outline of mechanisms for human recovery, including rest, diet, and therapeutic starvation. It then goes on to describe the use of low intensity microwave and mm-wave radiation for biological/biomedical applications. This includes: radiation therapy; cancer treatment; growth enhancement in the fish industry; and microwave treatment of seeds for increased viability and growth.

articleTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology Conference Proceedings [front matter]
