publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Conference proceedings front matter may contain various advertisements, welcome messages, committee or program information, and other miscellaneous conference information. This may in some cases also include the cover art, table of contents, copyright statements, title-page or half title-pages, blank pages, venue maps or other general information relating to the conference that was part of the original conference proceedings.

articleTitle: List of authors
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presents a list of the authors whose papers are published in the conference.

articleTitle: Microwave estimation of comfort of textile materials
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In order to estimate the comfort and compatibility of materials used for clothes manufacture, the authors propose to measure the factor of electromagnetic radiation using microwave radiometric equipment. Materials were heated in a thermostat with a temperature of 37.0/spl plusmn/0.5/spl deg/C, that corresponds to the temperature of the human body in comfortable climatic conditions. The estimation of emissivity coefficient was carried out at a frequency of 52 GHz. The estimation of microwave radiation has shown, that natural materials (fur, leather, cotton, flax) are the most favorable for the human organism. They are recommended for the manufacture of winter clothes, since in thermal contact with the human body these materials provide the minimum of microwave energy absorption, and thus they do not let the body cool down. For the warm period it is recommended using synthetic and mixed materials.

articleTitle: Solid 5-bit attenuator for 1-12 GHz band
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes the development of a monolithic GaAs 5 bit digital 1-12 GHz attenuator with minimum attenuation step of 0.5 dB. This broadband MMIC uses MESFETs in the passive mode as variable resistors, their drain-source resistance varied using the gate voltage.

articleTitle: Optical technologies of calibrating and aligning radiotelescope paths
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Control is achieved over the correlation of geometry of multimirror antennas and the absolute calibration of radiometers on large full-rotary antennas through the use of thermal radiators. It allows for measurements of absolute flows from natural radio sources.

articleTitle: Experimental study of a rectangular DRA
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents an experimental investigation of scattered fields for dielectric resonant antenna (DRA) in the form of a dielectric parallelepiped having a high permittivity (/spl epsiv/=89). The resonant frequencies of different modes for the given dielectric resonator have been calculated. Analysis of scattered fields in the near zone and comparison of theoretical calculations to the experimental results allow us to find the required resonant mode.

articleTitle: Progress in increasing of space TWT efficiency
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, the authors review the basic physics of increasing space helix TWT efficiency, as well as advances in this field for the period 1999-2001. The authors believe that in the next 10 years, 85% efficiency of irregular space TWTs will be achievable.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional numerical model of two-island single-electron structures
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The two-dimensional numerical models of two-island single-electron structures are developed. The model allows one to achieve good agreement with the experimental data. A comparison with results from other known models is also carried out. The proposed model has been included in the program complex for the simulation of multiple-tunnel junction single-electron devices MTJ-SET-NANODEV.

articleTitle: Creation of MITRIS-based wireless access communication system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Discussed in this paper are the problems of the creation and testing of a MITRIS-based wireless access telecommunication system. The creation of integrated service networks is an urgent task today. This paper presents the concept of a national information system development using IP technology and existing fiber-optic (IP/MPLS, IP/ATM, IP/SDH, IP/Gigabit Ethernet, IP/FG-Ethernet), cable (xDSL) and wireless (IEEE802.11, GSM, GPRS, xMDS) systems. Information space unity is easy realized using the national distributive system MITRIS. The provision of extra services is available: high speed duplex data transfer; digital telephony; Internet access; TV and radio broadcasting. It is possible to create a national telecommunication system at the worldwide level without heavy expense.

articleTitle: Influence of a finite length of a dielectric waveguide on the acceleration of electrons by wake fields of a train of bunches
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The excitation of wake fields by a train of relativistic electron bunches in a cylindrical waveguide partially filled with dielectric is considered. The waveguide finiteness along the longitudinal direction is accounted for by the introduction of the wake field trailing edge which propagates at the velocity equal to the group velocity of the resonance wave. The numerical simulation of self-consistent dynamics for particles and for the acceleration of electrons in wake fields is carried out.

articleTitle: Beam-forming circuits for multibeam antenna array
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the feed system for passive RF transmission line. The general feed system for connecting 2/sup n/ inputs with 2/sup n/ elements is presented. It consists of conventional hybrid junctions with associated phase shifters. In order to increase the possible number of elements in the array, it is necessary to find applicable junctions, which are more complex than the hybrid ones. 3-input/output junctions, as well as 4-input/output junctions are presented. They are used in multiple feed networks, expanding the number of elements in the array up to 2/sup L/3/sup M/4/sup N/.

articleTitle: High Q shielded dielectric resonator - the basis of stable MM-waves generator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: High Q-factor whispering gallery modes which are excited in a shielded hemispherical dielectric resonator by an external signal or Gunn diode are investigated. Their application as modes of an oscillator with high frequency stability is proposed. The power of the output signal and frequency tuning of an oscillator based on the investigated resonator are measured.

articleTitle: Snap of microwave plasmatron operation stability within pressure range in medium vacuum
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A snap of microwave plasmatron operation stability within the pressure range in medium vacuum was developed and tested on the basis of an optical diagnostics technique. The essence of the technique is simultaneous synchronous recording of the signal from the vacuum-gauge analog output and the signal from the photoelectric multiplying tube. Recording is carried out during plasmatron pumpout from the moment of gas cut-off to the moment of discharge starvation. We compared the data obtained during investigation of microwave discharge stability in different modes of plasma generation with the results of the snap of discharge glow properties. Such analysis proves the reliability and high informativity of the developed technique.

articleTitle: Microwave accelerometer and tachometer
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the development of a remote vibration amplitude and frequency (vibrating acceleration) and also object rotation speed meter are presented. The range of measured parameters are: rotation speeds of 180 to 80000 RPM, vibration frequency of 3 Hz to 10 kHz, and vibration amplitudes up to 5 mm. The device operates in a 5 mm wave band.

articleTitle: Insertion loss in solid state transistor phase shifters
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper outlines the research into the possibility of decreasing insertion losses in monolithic transistor phase shifters. Technological limitations related to manufacturing monolithic phase shifters are described.

articleTitle: A way of converting directional patterns in receiver antennas
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A way of controlling shapes of directional patterns with the aid of fragmented Fresnel zones is suggested. Directional patterns of horn and helical antennas have been measured. Amplitude distributions of field components in short, medium and long-range zones for various frequency bands have been obtained and analyzed. 3D 'intensity/angle/radius' images for long-range and short-range zones have been derived from the experiments.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of a radiation field for a one-mirror hybrid mirror antenna
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Mathematical equations for a far-field region of a hybrid-mirror antenna with a parabolic reflector and an array of helical radiators as a radiator are obtained.

articleTitle: Using of MITRIS system within territorial information network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the fundamental conceptual regulations of development of territorial information networks on the basis of MITRIS system. It is shown, that such networks allow to create united teleinformation space of Ukraine.

articleTitle: The effect of gamma-irradiation on the operating parameters of group III nitrides-based field effect transistors
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of gamma ray irradiation on the properties of AlGaN/GaN based HEMTs has been investigated. It is shown that after being irradiated by gamma-quanta with a total dose of 10/sup 9/ rad the devices preserve their operational ability.

articleTitle: Controlled band-elimination filter of 8-mm waveband
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The experimental results of one method of amplitude-frequency characteristic shaping of a K/sub L/ stop-band filter are presented. These filters are based on waveguide-slot lines with a ferrite resonator placed into a gap in the slot line. The principle characteristics of such structures are the high attenuation level in the stop-band (around 40-50 dB), relatively low attenuation level in the pass-band (it is within 0.5 dB), effective band of tuning is about 10% from central frequency, and manufacturability.

articleTitle: Behavior of a mobile communication link in an urban environment: a test case
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents practical and theoretical results. The practical results were obtained during one test-drive made in Porto downtown (CBD), named Baixa. The practical results are compared with application of the theoretical models. The urban parameters were assumed to be position-independent. These results will be of importance for mobile cellular communication systems in macro and microcell scenarios in dense urban areas. Two models for downtown are presented: regression line fit (RLF) and Okumura baseline fit (OBF). The generated results confirm the good agreement with the zone under study, due to the lowest absolute mean errors and standard deviations generated.

articleTitle: Ensuring of reliability of discrete information reception in coherent FOTSI [fiber optic transmission systems]
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper are different reception homodyne schemes for coherent FOTSI interference immunity increase. Coherent FOTSI immunity depends on the optical oscillator shot noise and laser phase noise, stipulated by the finite width of the oscillation line of the optical sensor generator and oscillator. The reliability of discrete information reception in coherent FOTSI depends on the optical power of the receiver input signal, signal/noise ratio and on the digital information rate, which is the aggregate determined probability of binary symbol erroneous reception. Homodyne transmission systems with phase locked-loop frequency control optical circuits, on the basis of optical analog phase shifters or with external injection synchronization by optical signals, ensure phase error between the accepted carrier and reference signal does not exceed 0.2 rads. That allows us to reach a probability of binary symbol erroneous reception equal to 10/sup -9/.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic sensor of thermal field distribution in work chambers of microwave process installations
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principles of information derivation of the allocation of thermal fields in working chambers, with the help of fibre-optical sensors, are briefly considered. The concept of a uniform field of complexed fibre-optical sensors for monitoring microwave technological process system parameters is put forward. The principles of integration, methods of information acquisition by means of complexed fibre-optical sensors, and variants of their configuration, are considered.

articleTitle: A new circuit for stabilizing frequencies of low noise millimeter wave oscillators
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new circuit for low noise cavity stabilized millimeter wave oscillators has been developed. The circuit consists of stabilizing H/sub 011/ cavity, /spl lambda//sub g//4 electrical length transmission line, diode section and load. The diode section has a series resonance at the working frequency. To test the circuit, the 42 GHz GaAs IMPATT diode oscillator has been developed and investigated. The oscillator showed the phase noise reduction factor of about 50 dB. The noise level was at -89 dBc (1 Hz) at the 1 kHz offset frequency.

articleTitle: Autonomous Doppler radar meter of transport movement parameters
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents an autonomous radar Doppler navigator which is used to measure ground vehicle movement parameters. It is a mm-wave radar, which supports precision measurement of movement velocity, path and time of motion. The radar is specially designed for application on vehicles for navigation and control purposes.

articleTitle: Mirror antenna irradiator for digital communication systems
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The spread of wireless systems to Internet network connections, at the 2.4-2.485 GHz frequency band, is increasing (for example, with the help of cards installed in motherboard slots of personal computers). In this case, antennas should have vertical polarization gain of approximately 20 dB. At the faculty of radio engineering of the Sevastopol national technical university, feeds for such reflector antennas have been developed.

articleTitle: Broadband wireless access systems. Terms and definitions
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Various broadband access systems are described and classified in this paper. On the basis of the conducted analysis, a new kind of telecommunications has been determined - broadband wireless access systems. Great attention was paid to various terms and definitions of the considered broadband access systems.

articleTitle: Simulation of transient processes in two-dimensional open-resonance structures
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper we present an efficient algorithm of finite-difference method allowing one to obtain reliable and sufficiently complete information about transient processes over a plane. The solution was obtained for the problem of interaction between nonsinusoidal electromagnetic waves and dispersive elements. The initial boundary value problem describes the radiation, propagation and scattering process of nonsinusoidal E-polarized waves in free space. Inhomogeneities are presented by real finite functions and the absorbing conditions are calculated over a rectangular grid.

articleTitle: Biological effects of low intensive mm-waves
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper discusses the basic experimental laws of nonthermal millimeter wave interaction with various biological objects. These mm-waves are greatly absorbed by water and aqueous media. Microwave radiation is vastly absorbed by free molecules of water. It can change the properties of water both in the outer and inner medium in cells. Under the influence of mm-waves in liquid, convection takes place. Many biochemical processes including membrane processes are sensitive to the medium stirring media. The difference in the absorption capacity of bound and unbound water molecules stimulates non-additivity of microwave radiation absorption by aqueous solutions. This became the basis of the new trends in study of intermolecular interaction in solutes and solvents.

articleTitle: Test bench for investigation of awkward shaped signals influence on radioelectronic equipment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Studies of electronic equipment resistance to external electromagnetic interference has become an urgent problem due to many reasons. One of the most important reasons is the permanently complicated electromagnetic compatibility, caused by the increasing number of receiver-transmitter devices operating in the microwave band. To study the formation of chaotic states in electronic equipment, when affected by a complex sequence of short microwave pulses with variable pulse-to-pulse length, a specialized stand was developed.

articleTitle: Coupling factors of irregular microstrip quarter-wave resonators
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The coupling factors of pair of quarter-wave microstrip resonators having full length of coupling area of irregular strip conductors with stepped width were investigated. It is theoretically and experimentally shown that given passband in such a microstrip structure can be realized at three greatly different spaces between resonators.

articleTitle: Clock systems of reference generators in communication networks of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper considers the methods of reference generator clocking in Ukrainian communication networks. It is shown that radio-meteoric clocking systems can be used independently, as well as for calibration of clocking systems with unknown fixed and random measurement errors.

articleTitle: Antinoise random coding of digital image information for increase of broadband communication systems efficiency
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposed in this paper is a new method of digital information processing in broadband telecommunication systems. The method is based on a physical analogue to optical holography. It allows the effective restoration of a data block from a small fragment.

articleTitle: AlGaAs/InGaAs/GaAs heterostructures based pHEMT
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of developing a pHEMT on AlGaAs/InGaAs heterostructures grown on a GaAs substrate are presented. The structures have electron mobility of 6400 cm/sup 2//(V/spl middot/s) and surface electron density of 1.2/spl times/10/sup 12/ cm/sup -2/ at room temperature. Using these structures, transistors with a 0.6-0.8 dB noise factor providing amplification above 11 dB have been developed.

articleTitle: Hybrid optoelectronic processor for complex signals detection
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A hybrid optoelectronic processor (HOEP) is discussed for interception of spread-spectrum signals. HOEP integrates an electrooptical array antenna and an interferometer for detection, angle-of-arrival estimation and spectrum analysis. This new acoustooptic structure is proposed for effective spread-spectrum signal processing.

articleTitle: Gunn oscillators based on shielded dielectric resonators with mechanical frequency tuning
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The features of Gunn oscillators based on shielded dielectric resonators with whispering gallery modes and ray oscillations are investigated. Their comparative analysis for oscillators with different dielectric resonant structures is carried out.

articleTitle: A multi-beam antenna for GSM base stations
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of developing a multi-beam antenna for GSM mobile phone base stations are presented and discussed. Using this antenna with the modern adaptive equipment of mobile phone base stations increases reception capabilities.

articleTitle: Simulation of fractal-like antennas
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The system of computer modelling of complex radiating surfaces, including fractal-like structures, is considered in the work. The base of the system is the grid model of the radiating surface of an antenna. The system allows interactive change of antenna geometry, to analyze the current distribution in the grid segments and the antenna diagram in different coordinate systems. The results of modelling of fractal-like radiating structures on the base of the von Koch curve and the Sierpinski triangle are presented.

articleTitle: 3D model of urban radiochannel and calculation algorithm [cellular systems]
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A radio-channel model has been designed as a set of impedance parallelepipeds, simulating buildings. An algorithm and software have been developed, which allows the calculation of radiowave propagation in close urban conditions. Experimental researches of electromagnetic wave propagation in the city have been conducted.

articleTitle: Application of ATDP suite for electronic system evolution operator restoration and classification [microwave receiver EMI testing]
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The application of the adaptive testing and data processing (ATDP) software suite in electromagnetic tests of microwave receivers demonstrated the possibility for analysing and interpreting dynamic characteristics of a complex nonlinear system.

articleTitle: Autodistracktoric treatment of locomotor apparatus dysfunction by microwave stimulation of tissue regeneration
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This report considers the rehabilitation of people with locomotor apparatus dysfunction including those diseases complicated by inflammatory processes. The proposed system provides required mutual location of fracture separate fragments as well as their movement by three independent actuators with unique kinematics. The actuators generate specified movement velocity of either of three kinematics pairs within the range 0.05-5 mm/24 hours. We have proposed unique methods of bone tissue stimulation by microwaves with radiation intensity up to 10 mW/cm/sup 2/. Experimental models of the autodistracktoric system with microwave stimulation of regeneration in combination with simulation by a constant magnetic field and microelectrophoresis in biologically active points (e.g. using mumye solution) are patented in Ukraine. Some experimental laboratory elements of the autodistracktoric system have been manufactured and tested. The following tasks are to be fulfilled: development of both schematic and structure of the automatic autodistracktoric system, providing movement of separate fracture fragments to optimize the bones knitting; wide introduction of elements stimulating processes of tissues regeneration, where the regeneration is accelerated by 10 times owing to the complex influence on the fracture region and biologically active points of various physical factors, such as microwave radiation, constant magnetic fields, and microelectrophoresis; development of a system for domestic utilization; manufacture of autodistracktoric system pilot models, testing, and preparation of documents for batch production.

articleTitle: Objects identification in non-linear radars
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article describes a method of clearer discrimination of returning nonlinear radar signals. By analyzing, and audio demodulating of received signals, more accurate results are achieved. A way of accurate discrimination between electronic targets and innocent objects is given. It is based on second harmonic analysis. There is no need for third harmonic analysis in the receiver because the dependence the relative strength of harmonics does not always have a single meaning.

articleTitle: Microstrip bandpass filter with high suppression level
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design of microstrip filter with lumped tapped-inductive couplings is proposed. It is shown that in such a design, due to excluding electromagnetic couplings between resonators, it is possible to increase significantly the attenuation in stop-bands of frequency response. Besides, the use of conductive-inductive couplings allows reducing the overall dimensions of filters.

articleTitle: Correction of independent errors and byte-type errors in communication systems using structured codes
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Current publications devoted to noise-proof coding, declare that byte-type error detection and correction are particularly effective. However, independent errors up to t-multiplicity may appear in transmitted code-words. Taking account the above, it is necessary to develop codes, to enable the correction of the above error types with fine veracity of the information transmitted, possessing simple decoding algorithms, and not requiring delay of data exchange. This paper suggests codes, which are able to decode data blocks with q/sub 5/<10/sup -6/ error probability per one symbol at q/sub 0/=0.05 error probability per one symbol in the received word. These codes are able to correct byte errors of several bytes length. It is evident that such codes possess relatively lower transmission rate than BChH codes.

articleTitle: Heat-resistant Au-ZrB/sub x/-n-SiC 6H Schottky barriers
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We present the results of our research into morphological and electrical properties of ZrB/sub x/-n-SiC 6H and Au-ZrB/sub x/-n-SiC 6H surface-barrier structures. They were studied both before and after a 90 s rapid thermal annealing (RTA) in vacuum at the temperature T=1000/spl deg/C. The ZrB/sub x/ films were obtained using magnetron sputtering from pressed targets of stoichiometric composition. It was shown that the RTA changed neither contact layered structure nor the abrupt character of the interface, and the contact barrier properties were retained. For the initial (pre-RTA) samples the Schottky barrier height /spl phi//sub B/ was 0.69-0.78 eV; post-RTA, it became 0.59-0.70 eV.

articleTitle: Combination probing of atmosphere boundary level using acoustic, radio-acoustic and thermal methods
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown that the simultaneous atmosphere boundary layer sounding by acoustic, radioacoustic and radiometric methods can give a useful effect much more than a sum of the useful effects of each method.

articleTitle: Theoretical and experimental investigation of cold emitters for alenotron amplifiers
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The conditions for achieving maximal emission current in multipactors are investigated analytically on the basis of single-particle models with regard to the mirror image field. The possibility of increasing emission current are suggested. The experimental results of a 3 GHz alenotron research are considered. A current of 150 mA has been achieved.

articleTitle: Analysis of a phased array antenna based on phase-shifters with ferroelectric varactors
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of theoretical analysis and experiments for separate parts and elements of a flat multilayer microstrip phased array antenna based on phase-shifters with ferroelectric varactors are presented. Mutual coupling and crosspolarization phenomena between radiator elements of two-layer patch aperture have been theoretically and experimentally studied. Calculated and measured data on the phase-shifter parameters are presented.

articleTitle: An ultrawideband Vivaldi antenna with enhanced feeding system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Simulated and measured results of an ultrawideband Vivaldi radiators are presented. An enhanced feeding system of this antenna allows us to increase the operating frequency band. A good matching (VSWR better than 2) in the prototype and sufficiently low insertion losses over a three-octave frequency interval were reached.

articleTitle: Efficiency and compatibility of bio-resonance information-puncture therapy (BRIPT) and other effects at complex chronic ailment during rehabilitation period
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper states the experience of management of patients with plural chronic pathology using the curative-diagnostic complex "Ramed-Expert" in the conditions of a rehabilitation department. Efficiency of the complex application of K-band therapy with information-resonance therapy, exercise therapy, laser treatment and preliminary cleansing programs without negative reaction for organisms are shown.

articleTitle: VXI-based automatic scalar network analyzer system in 2-118.1 GHz frequency range
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An automatic scalar network analyzer system in the 2-118.1 GHz frequency range has been designed on the basis of the VXI bus. Features of the system include: wide dynamic range; solid-state synthesized source with 0.3 Hz step and /spl plusmn/5/spl times/10/sup -8/ frequency uncertainty; pure source signal spectrum, with harmonic and nonharmonic spurious suppression of more than 40 dB; calibration with interpolation through the entire frequency range; a convenient user interface; hard copy output to a printer; modular system architecture with flexible options and possible performance expansion; two independent measurement channels with arbitrary choice of measuring parameter (including transmission/reflection), frequency and number of points; available options to 178 GHz and/or with inch-based waveguides according to IEC standards.

articleTitle: Investigation of composites dielectric and magnetic properties within the frequency band 0.3 to 2.5 GHz
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The permittivity and permeability of two-phase composites consisting of carbonyl iron powder embedded in paraffin wax are measured at different frequencies and concentrations of the powder. The analysis of the data obtained at low volume fractions of the powder in the terms of the dilute model yields estimates for the inherent permeability of the filling agent as well as for the structural characteristics of the composites under study.

articleTitle: Methodology of estimation of data transfer efficiency in telecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposed in this paper is a method of estimation of data transfer efficiency during control cycles, based on a mathematical formulation of information exchange under conditions of external influence, as well as integral equations, numerical algorithms and efficiency indexes calculation.

articleTitle: Receiving antenna patterns transform [image restoration]
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new method is described for the image restoration of objects for various wavelengths. Results are submitted for approbation of the given method for the Sun in the visible area.

articleTitle: Gyrotrons with travelling T-wave resonators
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown, that in single-stage devices efficiency more than 30% on the first harmonics of cyclotron frequency and 20% on the second harmonics, in two-cascade devices respectively 60% and 50%, are achieved. Whereas in considered devices there is no effect of a dynamic stratification of a beam, their power in essence is not limited in SHF band.

articleTitle: Electropuncture diagnostics results interpretation at mm-wave therapy conducting
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Lanthanides application in planar technology of microwave devices production
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown that rare-earth doping of silicon can be useful in the technology of SHF-devices. The use of silicon doped by rare-earth elements (REE) as substrates for epitaxial layers allows the improvement of the stability of p-n junctions and MOS-structures to radiation effects.

articleTitle: A flat folded dipole-based DMW antenna
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of an investigation of an antenna based on a folded dipole are presented. The antenna has a flat radiation structure and a loop of a feeding coaxial cable, while the oscillator is excited by a cable located in the gap of the radiating structure. The design also incorporates a screen located at a distance of approx. 1/4 of a medium wavelength from the structure. The antenna developed for a 600 MHz medium frequency satisfactorily matches the 50 /spl Omega/ cable over a 385-940 MHz range.

articleTitle: Methods and equipment for electrophysical monitoring and MM-wave correction of human organism state
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We developed the methods and equipment for electropuncture express-diagnostics of functional state of a human organism by measuring of electrophysical skin parameters, as well as EHF-correction, using the influence of low intensity electromagnetic EHF-radiation. Discussed in this work is the possibility of a cybernetic approach to the control of biosystem functional status on the basis of a homeostasis model.

articleTitle: Correlation meter of electromagnetic radiation intensity
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An opportunity for the construction of a low level intensity meter for electromagnetic radiation in a range of high and superhigh frequencies is considered. The structure of the meter is offered and an operating algorithm is proscribed which ensures a heightening of the exactitude of measurements.

articleTitle: Investigation of some molecular damage mechanisms and growth of uni-cell algae using the method of mm-wave dielectrometry
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents data on dielectrical characteristics of algae culture at various growth stages obtained using dielectrometry methods. The experimental results show the possibility of analysis of response mechanisms of living cells under the influence of biologically active substances on cellular structures. The influence of phytohormone on the cellular culture in a stationary and logarithmic phase was investigated.

articleTitle: Developed method of reflection separation at measurement of bi-pole parameters on microwaves
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The "reflections separation" method (RSM), used for exact measurement of small reflection coefficients of two-poles on the ultrahigh frequencies, is investigated and advanced. Increasing the accuracy of a method and characteristics optimization of the devices used in RSM, is achieved due to realization of computer simulation in the method.

articleTitle: Corporative territorial network based on MITRIS software/hardware
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The characteristics and operation technology of a backward channel set up for broadband Internet access has been presented previously. This paper considers the set up of a territorial corporate computer network for geographically-distributed objects monitoring. We consider creation of computer network intended for the monitoring of wind power stations. Such stations are located basically in the Crimea and in the south of Zaporozhye and Kherson regions.

articleTitle: Optimization of antenna-feeder assembly of mobile communication station
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Synthesis of collinear antenna array is presented in order to improve radiation pattern in vertical plane.

articleTitle: Calculation of properties of compact magnetron anode module
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown, that resonator of investigated miniature magnetron has only three modes in octave frequency band and that the field of /spl pi/-mode is distributed non-uniformly along the axial direction of the resonator, increasing essentially near to the ring straps.

articleTitle: Plasma polaritron instability in semiconductor superlattice
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The conditions of instability of plasma polaritons in infinite structures, which were derived by a periodic recurrence of two alternating semiconductor layers, was considered. It was assumed that carrier drift takes place. The conditions for the appearance of the instability and its increments of growth were derived.

articleTitle: Influence of excitation conditions of resonator with longitudinal coupling slot on the amplitude-phase distribution in waveguide-slot antenna
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence on the radiation characteristics of a single radiating slot has been researched on the basis of the solution of the resonator excitation problem by a longitudinal slot and loaded radiating slots. Calculations of the resonance linear waveguide-slot array with a required amplitude-phase distribution (APD), with regard to the internal and external interactions between the radiating slots, were carried out.

articleTitle: Ecological problems of development and use of microwave information technologies
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problems of electromagnetic field influence on a human being are considered. It is suggested to define physiologically substantiated norm of microwave irradiating power proceeding from analysis of a biosystem absorption and reflection mode.

articleTitle: Calibration test of 12-pole microwave circuits analyzer, based on discrete Fourier transform
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A microwave network analyzer calibration procedure and computer simulation of this procedure are considered. The mathematical model of a six-port reflectometer calibration is described.

articleTitle: Multipurpose integrated module for satelite data reception within 1.65-2.25 GHz band
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Recently, methods of reception and processing of remote sounding data, transmitted from weather satellites have been actively under development. This paper describes the basic characteristics, block diagram and design of a multipurpose module for satellite data reception within the 1.65-2.25 GHz band.

articleTitle: About calibration features of microwave noise meter
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Microwave noise meter measurement accuracy depends both on the measurement method and the method selected for meter calibration. For amplitude noise measurement, using the direct detection method, it is necessary to know the value of coefficient which characterizes the shape of the diode detection curve. In addition, it is necessary to know the steepness of the phase detector for phase noise calibration.

articleTitle: Microwave communications in real urban conditions
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of distribution of electromagnetic waves in range 200-4500 MHz along a surface with deep modulation of a relief is reviewed in case when the source of radiation is located on border or it is directly situated in the area of spatial modulation of a relief. The methods used for the decision of similar problems are analyzed, their comparative analysis is conducted, conditions and limits of applicability are investigated. The new theoretical concept of distribution of electromagnetic waves in conditions of an actual urban or geographic landscape founded on a hypothesis of the resonant interaction of electromagnetic fields with low intensity high harmonics of Fur'e-decomposition of a surface relief is offered. The theoretical model and the mathematical method of the description were developed.

articleTitle: A power electrovacuum device with a magnetron-type triode electron gun
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A research into static conditions of the power electrovacuum device with a magnetron-type triode electron gun is presented. Conclusions are made about the prospects of applying such devices in generating and modulator modes, as well as in an adjusting valve mode for high-voltage electronic current regulators and in the inertia-free breakdown protection systems for VHF high-voltage power generating devices.

articleTitle: Monte-Carlo method application for calculation of losses in microwave devices
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We propose using of Monte Carlo methods for the calculation of losses in integral dielectric microwave devices. Losses in a waveguide bend were calculated to demonstrate the applicability of this method.

articleTitle: Influence of circular-polarized waveguide radiator length on amplitude and polarization beam patterns
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The change of amplitude and polarization patterns of the circularly polarized radiator in form of the open end of a circular waveguide in dependence on its length was studied experimentally with help of a rotating indication linearly polarized antenna. It is shown that if the radiator length is more than quarter-wavelength in free space, the characteristics of the waveguide radiator are approximately the same as for the half-infinite waveguide.

articleTitle: Optimization of electrically lengthy longitudinal slots patterns
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Antennas in the form of lengthy longitudinal slots cut in walls of rectangular cross-sectioned waveguides are the most simple and practically feasible type of leaky wave antennas. In this paper, the lengthy longitudinal slots cut in a wide wall of a rectangular waveguide are investigated. The thickness of the waveguide walls was taken into account in numerical calculations.

articleTitle: Microwave amplifier theory for a waveguide with a distributed semiconductor structure based on the Smith-Purcell effect
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the context of the small signal theory a microwave amplification in a distributed semiconductor structure based on the Smith-Purcell effect has been investigated. The plasma in a semiconductor was considered in quasi-hydrodynamic approximation. A characteristic equation has been obtained and its numerical solution has been arrived at.

articleTitle: Compact receiving and transmitting C-band converters for satellite communication stations
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the design of a compact C-band converter for terrestrial satellite communication stations. The authors propose basic methods for converter downsizing. These methods can be widely applied in other microwave devices.

articleTitle: High-stable 3-cm generators
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents a high stability generator in the 8.05-12.15 GHz frequency range. It outlines the generator's functioning principles and experimental results. This sweeping generator (SG) is based on a scheme which includes the best features from two schemes: direct generation and frequency multiplication. The generator has a simple scheme, high long and short term stability, and good frequency set-on accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of the software for BWA systems for analysis and design
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper observes the algorithm of the BWA design on the base of stated task of multistage optimization. The software employment is presented with simulation of a one-layer and two-layer structure of BW. Advantages of the two-layer structure are shown and the optimal parameters being entry requirements for the following design stages are determined.

articleTitle: Constant radiation frequency scanning with the aid of two variable frequency generators and a partially filled multislot waveguide
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In previous works, a scanning technique using two coherent sources with different frequencies f1 and f2, and located at different points of the feeder line, was considered. The superposition of waves from these sources on the nonlinear elements in a radiator results in the so-called wave of intensity. The filtration of one of the combination frequencies (for example, fluctuations at the frequency corresponding to the difference of frequency sources) was suggested. By modifying frequencies of the initial sources according to a certain law it would be possible to modify the difference of phases between adjacent radiators, and, consequently, produce a beam scanning variation without changing the radiation frequency.

articleTitle: Frequency dependence of Q-factor of high-Q adjustable HTSC circuit
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An investigation of the Q-factor of an adjustable HTSC circuit in the 8-32 MHz range is carried out. The loss mechanisms are considered, and the mechanisms responsible for the observed behaviour of the Q-factor are determined.

articleTitle: Resonant frequency calculation for tunable resonance HTSC filters with lumped parameters
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A comparison of experimental and accountable frequency features of reconfigurable HTSC filters, in the HF range, allowing the definition of the main factors and their influence on the resonance frequency, is made.

articleTitle: Selective etching of multilevel submicron structures in plasma-chemical reactor (PCR) with low ion energy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented here are the results of selective plasma-chemical and chemical etching of multilevel structures with submicron element sizes. Plasma-chemical etching was performed in a PCR, with closed electron drift, and the chemically active ion energy was controlled in the range from 15 up to 300 eV with a variable magnetic field. Argon, insulating gas, chladone-218, and their mixtures with oxygen, were used as working gases. This method was able to remove twenty technological layers with 0.15 /spl mu/m element size.

articleTitle: Experimental research of frequency tuning of power pulse orotron
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The well-known mechanism of frequency tuning in orotron needs to be corrected where the power devices are concerned. The first peculiarity is connected to the use of a two-row open periodic structure (OPS) that may be considered as a coupled-cavity chain having narrow (resonance) passbands. The condition of a double resonance when the proper frequency of open resonator (OR) coincides with the resonance of OPS may produce break elevation of output power and efficiency of orotron. The second effect is connected to the construction of OR in power orotrons where the length of OPS is chosen to be of the order of spherical mirror aperture. In such a case when the beam voltage augments (for given OPS period) the radiation angle is changed too increasing so-called "dynamic" diffraction losses that limit the range of orotron frequency tuning.

articleTitle: A flexible, cost effective, broadband-receiver unit for the next generation radio telescopes
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The Thousand Element Array (THEA) is the latest in a series of demonstrator projects on the development path towards a next generation radio telescope, such as the Square Kilometer Array (SKA) and the Low Frequency Array LOFAR. THEA is an outdoor phased array system that is able to detect several astronomical sources in the frequency band from 600 to 1700 MHz simultaneously in an environment with various RFI-sources. This article describes how high volume production issues like component and manufacturing costs change the design philosophy of modern radio telescopes. As an example, the development of the receiver unit for the THEA demonstrator is depicted. Measurement results of the performance are presented. The article ends with outcomes from THEAs "First Light" measurement campaign.

articleTitle: Microwave diagnostics of cubic boron nitride
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of a study of cubic boron nitride (cBN) micropowder, synthesised at a controlled composition of reaction furnace charge. The possibilities of electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) techniques are shown for the control of the stoichiometric composition and quality of the BN microcrystals.

articleTitle: High-stable low-noise microwave oscillator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper describes a high-stability low-noise microwave oscillator. Limiting of power level at the input of the amplifying element ensures parameter stability. Results of a numerical simulation of the self-excited oscillator are presented.

articleTitle: Beam electronic control in air-based radars
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of R&D of fighter-jet phased arrays, carried out at the NIIP in the 1990s, are considered. A statement of the problems of designing active phased arrays for airborne radar is given.

articleTitle: H/sub 10/ wave reflectivity from rectangular waveguide aperture
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analytical expression for mode H/sub 10/ reflectance of the open-ended rectangular waveguide is obtained with the use of Weinstein's solution of a wave diffraction problem for a flat waveguide with an open end. Design dependences agree with precision experimental data within the limits of experimental and graphic errors.

articleTitle: Quantum wire FET simulation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are results of Quantum Wire Field Effect Transistor (QWFET) simulation. The influence of contact materials and dimensions on transistor characteristics is described.

articleTitle: 30 GHz ferroelectric phase-shifter on the basis of loaded microstrip line
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main goal of this work is the manufacture of a Ka-band ferroelectric (FE) phase shifter suitable for phase array antennas. The Ka-band (FE) phase shifters, which are viewed in this work, are based on the periodically loaded microstrip line.

articleTitle: Diffraction radiation oscillator with an open short-focus resonator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of experimental investigation of a diffraction radiation oscillator with an open (non-quasioptical) short-focus MM-wave (3-8 mm) resonator are shown. Specific features of modifying the output characteristics in such oscillators and the prospects of their future development are presented.

articleTitle: Microwave synthesizers for modern communication systems
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The development of frequency synthesizers for a PCE communication system revealed the possibility of constructing a series of low-cost synthesizers for 400 MHz-18 GHz, with a bandwidth of 10...15 %, frequency tuning step of 1-28 MHz and output power of 13 dBm. Within the frequency band 2-18 GHz, analog dividers are used, as well as hybrid-integral circuits of /spl times/2 and /spl times/4 frequency multipliers, which were developed and produced by FSUE . The phase noise level in the 2 cm band at offsets from the carrier of 1 kHz, 10 kHz and 30 kHz does not exceed -60 dB/Hz, -75dB/Hz and -90 dB/Hz, respectively. Further development of elements and microwave circuits in combination with more efficient modulation methods will allow the construction of new types of communication lines.

articleTitle: Measurement of dielectric permittivity tensor, main directions and optical axises in single-axis and bi-axis crystals
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We have designed a method of measuring the permittivity tensor components, permittivity ellipsoid axes and optical axes of uniaxial crystals with tetragonal, hexagonal, trigonal symmetry, as well as biaxial crystals with rhombic symmetry.

articleTitle: Microwave signals synthesizer
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of development of a microwave signal synthesizer for the 3 centimetre band for a coherent radar is presented. Its basic features are given.

articleTitle: Radiometric system for registration of nonequilibrium microwave radiation of living organisms
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper is detailed a high-sensitivity radiometric system for automated registration of nonequilibrium microwave radiation of living organisms. The system compares periodically the total and thermal components of the area being studied with further separation of nonequilibrium components.

articleTitle: Miniature wideband slotline antennas for phased array applications
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Miniature wideband antennas are used in phased array systems for several civilian and military applications. This work presents the results provided by several slotline miniature devices that can be manufactured in simple workshops. The feeders of such devices were coaxial cables with an impedance matching dummy cable extension. It may be shown that these structures are yet not optimized for the upper frequency bands, but still they offer promising performance.

articleTitle: Mixer nanodiode
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An experimental investigation of the properties of a NED nanodiode and a NED balanced harmonic mixer is presented. The conversion loss obtained by second-harmonic mixing at 3 cm was L=3+0.5 dB with LO power P/sub LO/=16 mW.

articleTitle: Properties of resonance PIN-attenuators based on lumped elements
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analysis results of lumped element PIN-attenuator characteristics are given. It is shown that phase drift in the attenuation control range rigidly depends on amplitude and frequency characteristic irregularity, and the best matching is provided when Ru=(0.7-0.8)/spl middot/Rum.

articleTitle: Influence of local magnetic irregularity on output properties of synchronized MM-wave generator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The theory of the single-frequency and multifrequency forced oscillations excitation in the online beam-wave system with local magnetic nonuniformity (LMN) is developed. The resonance characteristics of the steady-state oscillations are calculated. The main physical reasons for the synchronous and quasiperiodic oscillations excitation have been considered.

articleTitle: Electrostatic potential distribution in an eccentric channel with tubular electron beam
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference Microwave and Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of the static potential distribution in a cross-section of an equipotential cylindrical channel with a tubular electron beam has been performed for both symmetric and eccentric arrangements of the electrodes. It has been shown that a gradual change of the channel width does not allow for the formation of an effective natural ion trap in the azimuth direction.
